title: Preserve central ACK outcome when satellite executor evidence persistence fails
outcome: Classify and expose local post-commit executor evidence failure after an authenticated central mailbox ACK without claiming no mailbox write committed, and reconcile all remaining local affected rows from retained positive evidence.
acceptance: A fault after central ACK commit but before local executor Processed evidence preserves an accurate central outcome, never reports certified non-application of the central ACK, and supports bounded replay/recovery of remaining local evidence without settling unknown runtime effects.
A production-path regression and exact-input full gate pass with an independent read-only review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
